name: breakmyapp-workspace
description: Find, prove and reproduce bugs in your websites.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @breakmyapp/core && npm run build --workspace @breakmyapp/cli
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test --workspace @breakmyapp/core && npm run test:offline
scripts.test:offline: node --test scripts/doctor.test.mjs apps/studio/analysis.test.mjs scripts/studio-server.test.mjs examples/plugins/meta-description.test.mjs scripts/package-preview.test.mjs scripts/package-consumer-smoke.test.mjs scripts/smoke-scanner.test.mjs
scripts.verify:release: npm run build && npm run doctor && npm test && npm run test:browser && npm run test:consumer
